request_state.context: Established here this session: (a) Beal <=> no primitive solution with |chi| >= 1/12, where chi = 1/x+1/y+1/z-1; the Beal region has |chi| >= 1/12 (kernel-verified) and all ten known solutions have |chi| <= 1/18. (b) Positivity forbids cancellation: B^y < C^z <= 2B^y when A^x <= B^y, so C is pinned within a factor 2^(1/z) <= 1.26 of B^(y/z) (kernel-verified). (c) {A^x mod m : x>=3} = <A>, giving a congruence sieve rejecting 77.7% at m=240. (d) Classical descent is not a self-map. (e) Bases pairwise coprime, A != B, bases >= 2. BLOCKED: modular method on the all-even branch, Chabauty over the base field, abc/IUT (finiteness only), Darmon's program, naive search extension, Baker via the size window.

candidate.mechanism: Adelic / Brauer-Manin style obstruction. No single modulus obstructs (established). Ask whether the PRODUCT over all places carries an obstruction that no individual place does - the standard modern refinement when local obstructions individually fail.
candidate.why_new: A genuinely different level of the local-global machinery; its failure mode would be that the Brauer group is trivial, unrelated to any recorded obstruction.

genuinely_new.instructions: Is this mechanism materially different from every route already blocked in this project?

criteria.true: it draws on a different source of constraint and would fail for a different reason
criteria.false: it is a variant of a blocked route or meets the same obstruction

executable_here.instructions: Can a discriminating test be run NOW with exact computation, elementary derivation, or Lean - no Magma, no class groups of large fields, no unproved theorem?

criteria.true: a concrete test can be run immediately with the tools available
criteria.false: it needs machinery or theorems not available here

payoff.instructions: If the test came out favourably, how much would be learned?
criteria: level 2: a new necessary condition or a genuine search capability
level 3: an infinite family excluded, or the open problem genuinely reduced
